Theseus dashboard asset references: https://github.com/MrMilenko/Theseus
Imported stock xbox4.xbx orb art and cellwall.xbx texture, decoded losslessly to PNG. ASCII outlines from xbox.xtf and xbox book.xtf converted into embedded TrueType fonts. All retain their original designs.
Sources: Data/Skins/Stock/xbox4.xbx; xips-source/default-xbox/cellwall.xbx; Data/Fonts/xbox.xtf; Data/Fonts/xbox book.xtf.
Theseus license and asset provenance are included in Theseus-LICENSE.txt and Theseus-THIRD-PARTY.md. Microsoft retains rights to original dashboard assets; TeamUIX modifications carry their upstream terms. No Theseus executable is incorporated.

1.7.3 reconstruction: native Stock cellwall.xm and Main_memory_podshell_09/10/11 meshes, plus settings3 ClockIcon, GlobeIcon, StereoIcon, FullscreenIcon, network_icon, AutoOffIcon, ConsoleIcon, LockIcon and Icon_live geometry. Source XAP transforms are baked into the converted mesh data. Browser WebGL renderer reproduces source Waver and Spinner timing and stock falloff/chrome material colors, with lighting adapted for the browser. Clock hand offset and angles follow default-desktop/settings3.xap. GameHilite_01 and settings_home_bgpanel decoded from XBX. Source formulas referenced from scene_groups.cpp, camera.cpp and materials_desktop.cpp; upstream licenses remain included.
